notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are governmental funds here), so business_type is null. Basis for receipts/disbursements: Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (p5-6); balance sheet from Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1). Taxes line split using statement of activities (p2); State Sources split to carve out nameplate capacity (p3 and fund schedules); Non-Revenue Receipts split into insurance adjustments (p10) and the rest. Debt Service line split using the fund schedules (p17-19); the leasing corporation's 786,290 has no breakdown. Hidden transfer: General Fund line 2650 Vehicle Operation, Maintenance, & Purchasing 250,000 (p11) equals the Depreciation Fund transfer from the General Fund (p13); the statement's Operations and Maintenance 1,339,072 still includes it, so I removed it from spending and recorded transfers_out 250,000 (computed), with printed transfers_in 250,000 (net total column). Because of this, sum of disbursement items (12,597,302) differs from printed total 12,847,301 by the 250,000 reclassification (and 1 rounding). Printed roll-forward ties: 7,392,600 + 13,476,290 - 12,847,301 + 250,000 = 8,271,589; my items give 8,271,588 due to 1 rounding in the printed disbursements. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p9-12) is used for General Fund (more detailed than the General Fund components statement p7 and combining statement p8, which are not duplicated); the County Treasurer schedules (p21-22) and Other Governmental combining (p8) duplicate fund schedules and are not recorded. Detail lines with zero actual (and budget-only lines such as 1910, 6200 Title I ESEA, Budget Contingency, 4700) are omitted except 2211 shown at 0. Spending detail has no object breakdown, so detail_category is 'not itemized'. General Fund detail total 9,822,556 includes the 67,400 transfer (shown as other financing); the 250,000 reclassified transfer is also in other financing, so expenditure lines sum to 9,505,156 (printed less both transfers). Mid-schedule rounding of 1 in printed subtotals noted in report_discrepancies. Pages p1-p22 map to report pages 5-10, 31, 33, 34-47. Read pages 1-22 of 22.
